title: test(plugin-grid): the date-column face pin reads one frozen instant, so a run across midnight stays green
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9D7K4emLL9dNcp4rQPn22Dw)_

Fixes #34543

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 只改一个测试文件：表格日期列的测试在整个文件里冻结 `Date`,所有行和单元格读到的都是同一个「今天」。
- **为什么改：** 测试数据在收集时按「今天」生成，单元格渲染时又读一次「今天」。跑过 UTC 零点时，存成「后天」的那一行会被读成「明天」,Test UI 分片偶发变红(PR #34496 的运行 43981736011 实测过)。
- **风险与回滚：** 不碰产品代码，也不放松任何断言。只假造 `Date`,`waitFor` 和 React 用的计时器仍是真的。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.dateColumnOneFace-25884.test.tsx` 第 59 到 67 行。
- **两分钟验证：** `(cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.dateColumnOneFace-25884.test.tsx)`,预期 4 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的：** 不需要。本 PR 只改测试，由区线程审核后合入。

## What changes

`ObjectGrid.dateColumnOneFace-25884.test.tsx` builds its rows at collection from "today" (`storedDay(offset)`), and each cell reads "today" again when it renders. A run that crosses 00:00 UTC between the two reads a row stored as +2 days as "Tomorrow". The file now freezes `Date` once, at module top, before the rows are built: `vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] })` and `vi.setSystemTime('2026-06-15T23:59:59.900Z')`, the worst instant (a tenth of a second before midnight). `afterAll` restores real timers. Only `Date` is faked; the timers `waitFor` and React use stay real. No assertion changed and no source file moved, so no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

## Tests

- The fixed file, three runs in a row: 4 of 4 pass each time.
- Forced crossing, a one-off and not kept: `vi.setSystemTime('2026-06-16T00:00:00.100Z')` placed before case D's render turns the file red with `expected 'Overdue 4d' to be 'Overdue 3d'`. That is the same class as the CI failure (`expected 'Tomorrow' to be 'In 2 days'`, PR #34496 run 43981736011, Test UI 9/16 at 00:04Z). The file was restored after, `git diff` empty.
